subject.title: fix(providers): authenticate and scope inbound delivery

question: Should existing credential-less WhatsApp mock configurations retain a compatibility mode, or should this PR intentionally make appSecret and verifyToken mandatory for every adapter instance?
rationale: The repository policy favors provider-native authentication, while current released behavior and examples permit credential-less local mocks; choosing the permanent upgrade contract requires maintainer intent rather than an automated code-only judgment.

options.title: Complete the strict migration
options.body: Make both credentials formally mandatory, update every example and setup surface, and add explicit fresh-install and upgrade-failure coverage.

options.title: Retain loopback compatibility
options.body: Keep authenticated delivery while preserving safe local-only fallback credentials or an explicit compatibility mode for existing loopback mock configurations.

options.title: Split the WhatsApp change
options.body: Land the independent Slack, Telegram, and script fixes separately while the WhatsApp upgrade contract is resolved.

recommendation.title: Complete the strict migration
recommendation.body: Make both credentials formally mandatory, update every example and setup surface, and add explicit fresh-install and upgrade-failure coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent current-main provider implementation history and authored this draft’s proposed strict behavior.
